changelog: A collection's own page wraps its films into a grid instead of one sideways line; Up Next cards keep one menu button (Open Page lives in it) instead of two; services shown by app icon (NOW, Sky Go, BBC iPlayer) drop the name under it; the JustWatch credit under Also On is a small grey caption; button rows on other plugins' pages (Intro Skipper's libraries and shows) sit centred.
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
name: Hera TV
overview: The Apple TV app's look for Jellyfin's web client
